uxvr19.description_en:
Got a box sitting at [LOCATION] that needs to make its way over to [DESTINATION]. Any chance you can knock this out real quick?
Might be the easiest gig I’ve ever assigned out. Only real threat would be tripping over your own feet. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.
Stows out.
uxvr19.description_zh:
在 [LOCATION] 有个箱子需要送到 [DESTINATION]。你能不能快点把这个搞定？

这可能是我分配的最简单的任务了。唯一的危险就是绊倒自己。带个手持式牵引光束也是个聪明选择。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

1b0hq95.description_en:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So [TARGET] tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it.
Last we heard they were spotted around [LOCATION]. We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.
Do it quick and clean.
Stows out.
1b0hq95.description_zh:
有个小角色以为他们可以没有代价地袭击猎头帮。所以 [TARGETNAME] 试图抢走我们的一处藏匿点，还以为自己能逃脱。

我们最后听说他们在 [LOCATION] 附近被发现。我们需要有人过去，给他们传达一个非常明确的信息：谁才是星系中的主宰。

干得干脆利落点。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

g8r8fd.description_en:
I'm getting pretty bloody sick of Citizens for Prosperity sticking their noses where they don't belong.
Started thinking that it might be pretty nice to ground their fleet for a little bit. We blow up their fuel tanks at [LOCATION] and those little pissheads won't be going nowhere quick.
Sound like your kinda thing?
-Stows out
g8r8fd.description_zh:
我对繁荣公民插手不该管的事感到非常厌烦。

我开始觉得让他们的舰队暂时趴一阵子可能会不错。让我们在 [LOCATION] 炸掉他们的燃料罐，这些小家伙就不会轻易动了。

这听起来像是你喜欢的事吗？

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

18zfm32.description_en:
We've received a distress call from [LOCATION]. A group of unknown assailants have launched an attack. There have been multiple deaths reported and we need to reclaim the outpost.
I know this is far from your current position, but we're desperate to secure the area and get the outpost back and running again.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
18zfm32.description_zh:
我们收到了来自 [LOCATION] 的求救信号。一群身份不明的袭击者发起了攻击，已经报告了多起死亡事件，我们需要夺回这个前哨站。

我知道这离你现在的位置很远，但我们迫切希望能确保该地区的安全，恢复前哨站的运转。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

1xc3gnr.description_en:
Hello,
Some sad news. Unfortunately our hauler ran into some trouble and had to abandoned the cargo they were due to deliver. We haven't heard anything back from them so we're assuming the worse.
We're in the process of contacting their family and are conscious this is a very sensitive time, but also can't afford to leave a job incomplete. Our trackers show the cargo is still intact over at [LOCATION].
If you could finish the delivery we would be really grateful. We're not picking up on any nearby ships so it should be safe for you to collect. Bring a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Deliver the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we'll take care of the rest.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
1xc3gnr.description_zh:
你好，

坏消息。我们的运输员途中遇险，被迫遗弃了本应送达的货物。至今杳无音信，我们只能做最坏打算。

我们正在联系他们的家人，也明白现在是特别敏感的时刻，但实在没法放着任务半途而废。我们的追踪器显示，那批货物还在 [LOCATION] 那儿，完好无损。

要是你能把这批货送完，我们真的非常感激。目前没探测到附近有别的飞船，应该挺安全的，你去取就行。记得带把重型牵引光束，再开一艘能装得下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的船。

把货送到 [DESTINATION] 那儿的货运电梯就行，剩下的交给我们来处理。

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

124h0nx.description_en:
Heyo,
Over at [LOCATION] we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need [FUELTYPE]. Talk about when it rains it pours!
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run.
It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
124h0nx.description_zh:
嘿，

在 [LOCATION] 那边，我们刚接到一项为整支小型舰队加油的任务，他们一共需要 [FUELTYPE]。

不幸的是，他们所在的区域并非什么好地方，因此你在干活期间务必要警惕任何不法分子的捣乱。

最好是尽快让他们全部恢复航行。

ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
Got a big league bounty contract that’s primed to be executed. [TARGET] and their crew were identified executing a raid on [LOCATION]. If their MO holds true, [TARGET] has surfaced to land a big score and then will disappear into the ether. Let's not allow that to happen again.
Word is the hostile forces have spread themselves across the location. That’ll make hunting down the precise location of [TARGET] difficult. In addition, expect the target to act defensively when under attack. In previous engagements, they remained hidden and directed their forces from afar. It is our recommendation that you focus on thinning out their allies first and force [TARGET] to come to their own defense. Would also advise you to bring plenty of ammo and even some support to help keep you from being overwhelmed.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

1c7gk0x.description_en: A band of hired guns has been sent to mess with our interests over at [LOCATION]. Seems someone has been tipped off that if the [OBJECTS] there are destroyed that it will severely interrupt Headhunter operations in the area. That's a problem I want you to fix. Not gonna lie, theses mercs are no joke. It'd be foolish to go it alone. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor 7 Council Scrip for a job well done. Stows out.
1c7gk0x.description_zh:
一群枪手被派来搅黄我们在 [LOCATION] 的生意。看来有人通风报信，说要是那里的 [OBJECTS] 被毁了，猎头帮在那片区域的行动就会大受阻碍。这正是个我得让你去解决的麻烦。

不跟你兜圈子了，这些佣兵可不是吃素的。单枪匹马去简直就是送死。所以你不仅要物资备齐，还得找几个信得过的朋友跟你并肩作战。

这次行动必须万无一失，所以只要干得漂亮，主承包商就能拿到 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证作为奖励。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

1r3f8ot.description_en:
Hey,
Need a reliable contractor to help us out with a bit of a situation.
Our of our haulers has dropped out mid-contract and now our client's cargo is stuck in transit. Think they were trying to negotiate a better rate with us, but that's not how Ling does business. Anyway, they're done and we desperately need the shipment finished.
Petra and I have been working with this client for years now and have built up a good rapport. Be a shame to throw that all a way because of an unreliable hauler. Can you head to [LOCATION] and collect the shipment? You'll need a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Take the shipment to the freight elevator over at [DESTINATION] and we'll get you paid as soon as. We'd really appreciate your help with this and I'm sure our client would too.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
1r3f8ot.description_zh:
嘿，

需要找个靠谱的承包商帮我们解个围。

我们一个运输员半道撂挑子了，客户那批货现在卡在半路上。估计是想跟我们重新谈判个更高价，但这可不是玲家快递的作风。反正人已经跑路了，我们急着把这单收尾。

佩特拉和我跟这客户合作好多年了，关系一直挺稳，真不想因为一个不靠谱的运输员全砸了。你能去 [LOCATION] 把货取走吗？记得带个重型牵引光束，再开艘能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的船。

货送到 [DESTINATION] 那边的货运电梯就行，我们马上结账。真挺感谢你搭把手的，客户肯定也一样！

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

zs21sc.description_en:
Are you an experienced contractor looking to increase your income with some security work? Or maybe you’re new to the field and are looking for some hands-on experience?
Foxwell Enforcement are looking for enthusiastic new contractors to help with local law enforcement. To see if you’re the right fit for us, we’d like for you to head over to <EM4>[LOCATION]<EM4> and support the security forces on site. Local gang members have been giving that spot problems. Help the local forces take care of these outlaws to qualify for more contract opportunities with Foxwell.
Contractors are employed on a strictly freelance basis. Foxwell expects contractors to supply their own weapons and armor and does not accept any responsibility for any injuries, damages, or deaths accumulated during the contract.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
zs21sc.description_zh:
你是一位经验丰富的承包商吗？希望通过一些安保工作增加收入吗？或者你刚入行，正在寻找一些实践经验？

承包商以严格的自由职业者身份受雇。福克斯韦尔期望承包商自备武器和护甲，并不对合约期间发生的任何伤害、损坏或死亡承担任何责任。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

Just got word of an abandoned ship with a fat stack of cargo ripe for the pluckin’. If you’re interested, you’ll need to head to [LOCATION]. Word might have gotten around, so there’s probably some skags hanging around, but just ghost them and get the stash.

Stows out.

把货物送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那里，我会给你报酬。

记得带上重型牵引光束，因为我不知道那些货物到底什么大小。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

If you could sort it out for me, that'd be great.

o9czw2.description_en:
Got word that Headhunters ships heading to [LOCATION] are coming under attack. Scans have revealed enemy forces in the wider region intent on targeting our ops.
There’s enough of them that it’s gonna take more than one person to clear away all that trash. If you can grab your gear and a few friends, I could really use you out there.
The specific attack areas and targets are evolving. Don’t worry about the details now. Just get there and I’ll let you know where you’re needed.
Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor a bonus 7 Council Scrip.
- Stows
o9czw2.description_zh:
收到消息说，猎头帮的飞船在前往 [DEFENDLOCATIONWRAPPERLOCATION] 的路上遭到了攻击。扫描显示，附近区域有敌对势力正打算对我们下手。

敌人数量不少，单靠一个人可搞不定这群垃圾。如果你能带上装备，再叫上几个朋友，那就真的帮大忙了。

具体的攻击地点和目标可能会随时变化，现在别管那些细节了。你先赶过去，我会告诉你需要去哪里支援。

只要处理得好，我会给主要承包人额外加个奖金：[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

69gpfo.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo
Approval code: = 1000
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
Got a transport in need of backup over at [LOCATION]. Signal was patchy, but their comms made it sound like a group of outlaws had gotten wind of what they were hauling and attempted to take it from them.
Considering the state of things before we lost contact, I'm considering this a recovery mission. Multiple hostiles are expected at the site, so a skilled crew is crucial for the success of this operation. There will be a high volume of cargo to deal with, so a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam will be needed.
Upon successful extraction of cargo, deliver to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

1akvp5.description_en:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.
A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [LOCATION] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.
Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.
This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.
Stows out.
1akvp5.description_zh:
这些异种威胁的杂种就像是蟑螂。每当你以为彻底消灭他们时，他们又会顷刻复生。看样子，他们又回到了往日的疯狂，正试图策划一些大事。具体是什么我们不得而知，但肯定是一场混乱，因此我们已获得许可，在事情发生之前予以制止。

据说一群异种威胁的高层正在 [LOCATION] 秘密会面，计划或发泄情绪，或者做其他事情，但我们打算捣毁这个聚会。或者，由你来完成。

前往那里，消灭你遇到的所有人。没错，我敢肯定那些大人物会参与进战斗，这是他们一贯的做法。

这将会很艰难。尽管我讨厌异种威胁，但他们在战斗中确实很厉害，所以要小心，如果可以的话带上帮手。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

v30va3.description_en:
Hi,
Citizens for Prosperity needs help moving supplies around one of our outposts. The boxes need to be picked up from [LOCATION] and taken to [DESTINATION].
Doesn’t sound too difficult, does it? Just make sure you’re wearing a comfy pair of shoes. Also, to make your life easier, I'd bring a handheld tractor beam with you.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
v30va3.description_zh:
嗨，

繁荣公民需要帮助，需要在我们的一处前哨站搬运物资。箱子需要从 [LOCATION] 拿起，然后运送到 [DESTINATION]。

听起来不太难，对吧？只要确保你穿着舒适的鞋子就行了。

另外，为了让你省点事，我想确保你带了一个手持式牵引光束。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

twn3dz.description_en:
Don’t know if you’ve heard, but there’s a bunch of ships over at [LOCATION] surrounding a burnt-out ship. You curious why? I know we are.
Think you can get in that wreck, grab the blackbox, and get out? We’ll pay you for it.
Based on the number of sketchy ships in the area, you should bring some friends with to watch your ass, unless you’re some crazy solo act, but we’d prefer if you actually survived this so you can drop off the blackbox at [DESTINATION] for us.
But hey, your call. As long as it gets done.
-Bit Zeros
twn3dz.description_zh:
你听说没？[LOCATION] 那儿一堆船围着艘烧得只剩架子的飞船，知道为啥不？我们可好奇死了。你能不能溜进那堆废铁里，找到黑匣子再溜出来？事成之后我们付钱。

这地方到处都是不靠谱的家伙，你最好带几个帮手盯着后背，除非你真打算一个人单干——但咱还是希望你能活下来，好把黑匣子送到 [DESTINATION] 这儿来。

不过嘛，咋干你说了算，只要事儿能办成。

- 零比特

1h6szfr.description_en:
Hey,
Any chance you’d be willing to do a haul into Pyro? I know it can get dangerous there but this is for a good cause. A group of new CFP members have moved to [DESTINATION] and had a tough time adjusting to life in the system. They all left stuff behind in Stanton, because their transporter didn’t have room, so we’ve been hired to pick it all up and bring it to them.
Here are the pick ups:
PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]
- [LOCATION 3]
- [LOCATION 4]
CFP leaders hope that bringing them this stuff will make the system feel more like home. Let’s make sure this one goes down smoothly. Remember to equip your handheld tractor beam, and a ship that can fit 2 SCU cargo containers.
Happy Hauling,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
1h6szfr.description_zh:
嘿，

你愿意跑一单去派罗吗？我知道那地方挺危险，但这事儿真挺有意义的。一群新加入繁荣公民的家伙刚搬去 [DESTINATION]，在星系里过得特别不不适应。他们东西全撂在斯坦顿了，因为他们的运输舱塞不下。我们这回就是去把他们家当全捡回来，送过去。

以下是取货地点：

取货地点（任意顺序）

[MULTITOSINGLETOKEN]

繁荣公民的领导们说，把这些东西送过去，他们才能觉得这地方像家。咱可得把这单干漂亮了。别忘了带上手持式牵引光束，再找艘能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的船，就稳了。


运货顺利，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

1ubq60b.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
1ubq60b.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 要获取这些矿物的详细产地列表，请查阅你的mobiGlas日志中的《采矿基础 #2：去哪里采矿》。

由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

请注意，为了加快这些材料未来的使用效率，它们必须在交付前进行精炼。这可以在任何精炼厂完成，其位置可在你的星图中找到。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

c1cs5e.description_en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******
RE: Missing Mining Team
WORK BRIEF:
One of our local crews set off for a dig and haven’t checked back in. With everything going on out there, people are starting to get a little worried, so we’d like someone to try and get eyes on them.
I hate to say this, but if something happened to them, could you please identify everyone you find so we can let next of kin know?
PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.
AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
c1cs5e.description_zh:
*********** 人民联盟 ***********
******/ “团结就是力量” /******

回复：失联的采矿小组

工作简报：
我们本地的一个船员出发去采矿后就没再回过话。眼下外面局势这么乱，大家心里都开始犯嘀咕了，所以我们想请你帮忙去看看他们的情况。

说句难听的，万一真出了事，也请尽量辨认出你找到的所有人，好让我们通知他们的家属。

报酬：
确认全体成员状态后，按标准列出的费率结算。

授权人：
雷科·巴塔利亚

h0fbpc.description_en:
MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: Seemingly unsatisfied with their takings in Nyx, an outlaw group lead by [TARGET] has been planning a major strike against the UEE. This cannot be allowed to come to pass.
Thanks to the work of our Intelligence team, we've been able to track them down to [LOCATION].
Head there as soon as you can and engage before they have a chance to leave the system. Based on our strategic analysis, we recommend a well-armed and skilled fleet will be necessary for the successful completion of this mission.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
h0fbpc.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：看样子他们在尼克斯的收获还不够满意，由 [TARGETNAME] 领导的一伙不法分子正策划对 UEE 发动大规模袭击，这一计划绝不能得逞。

多亏了我们情报部门的努力，我们已找到他们锁定在 [LOCATION]。

请尽快赶到那里，并在他们逃离星系前发动攻击。根据我们的战略分析，成功完成此次任务需要一支装备精良技术娴熟的舰队。


此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯内容是一份非约束性的提议，一旦接受，任何一方都可以在不另行通知的情况下立即终止。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并且必须遵守 UEE 和相关星系的法律。

1g4g94a.description_en:
Got an orange level contract for any available combat pilots. A [SHIP] is under attack around [LOCATION] and is in desperate need for assistance. We're not sure how many perpetrators there are, but they seem motivated and dangerous so exercise caution.
Once on site, engage and destroy any hostiles you encounter and protect the client. Once they've transferred the credits, we'll route you your payment.
Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
1g4g94a.description_zh:
这有一份橙色级别的合约提供给任何有空的战斗飞行员。一艘 [SHIP] 在 [LOCATION] 附近遭到攻击，急需支援。我们不确定有多少不法分子，但似乎他们的动机明确且非常危险，因此请务必小心。

到达现场后，攻击并摧毁你遇到的任何敌对目标，保护客户。一旦他们转账了费用，我们会将你的报酬转给你。

尤金·沃尔顿
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

1ec1ssl.description_en:
Now then,
After the Nine Tails attack, the folks at Crusader could do with more than just a helping hand. What they need are proper propulsors to help replace the ones damaged in the attacks.
We've attached a blueprint for the TH-01 Propulsor that you can access at an Item Fabricator. Just search for it on the fabricator's terminal and you'll be able to see what materials are needed. Up to you whether you go out and find those materials yourself or buy them from a trader. (And if you don't have a fabricator yet, you'll have to purchase one at a shop, unload it at a freight elevator, and then set it up in a hangar or ship's cargo bay.)
Once you're done bring them to [DESTINATION] and one of the team will sort out the rest.
Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager
CORNERSTONE DEVELOPMENTS
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."
1ec1ssl.description_zh:
那么，

九尾袭击之后，十字军方面需要的不仅仅是一点帮助。他们真正需要的是合适的推进器，以替换在袭击中受损的那些。

我们已经附上了 TH-01 推进器的蓝图，你可以在物品制造机中访问它。只要在制造机的终端上搜索，就能看到所需的材料。至于你是亲自出去寻找这些材料，还是从商人那里购买，就由你决定了。无论哪种方式，你都需要使用物品制造机来自行制造推进器。（如果你还没有制造机，就得先在商店购买一台，把它卸到货运电梯上，然后将其设置在机库或飞船货舱中。）

完成后，请将它们运送到 [DESTINATION] 交付，届时有一个团队会负责后续事宜。

非常感谢，
哈尔·格里姆斯比
合约经理

基石开发公司
“立足过往之基石，建设我们的未来。”

1iz2pu4.description_en:
Looking for a tough and competent pilot in the area willing to take on some of the outlaws responsible for the attack on Crusader. We’ve received word that a group of Nine Tails stragglers are hunkering down near [LOCATION] after they got pushed out of Orison, and Crusader Security wants our help dealing with them while they’re down.
We’ve mapped out a good spot in the area to get the drop on them, so you’ll go there, wait quietly until they show up, and hit them before they know what’s happening. Hopefully this’ll send a message to the rest of them out there that their actions have consequences.
Good luck,
Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
1iz2pu4.description_zh:
正在寻找一位身手矫健且能力出众的飞行员，愿意接手打击那些袭击十字军的不法分子。我们收到消息，一群九尾的散兵被赶出奥里森后，正躲藏在 [LOCATION] 附近，十字军安保希望我们能趁其立足未稳时帮忙解决他们。

我们已规划好该区域的一个绝佳伏击点，你将前往那里，保持静默直到他们现身，然后在他们反应过来之前发起打击。希望此举能让他们的其余团伙明白，他们的所作所为必将付出代价。

祝你好运，

凯文·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

You'll most likely need a strong group of ships to successfully neutralize these Vanduul.

p13hxt.description_en:
Something weird is going on at the old Hathor mining facilities. Both the platform alignment facilities and orbital laser platforms have been abandoned and gathering dust for decades, but outlaws have started using them as a base of operations.
We’ve been hired by a concerned party who’s recently lost a lot of important cargo to one such gang. Currently, their stuff is stashed at [LOCATION1] and [LOCATION2], but there’s a growing fear that the gang may be offloading their goods soon. That’s why we’ve been hired to hit both of those Hathor facilities, retrieve the cargo from the freight elevators, and bring it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
Here’s the specifics on what to grab from each location. Doesn’t matter in what order you do this, as long as it all gets collected and delivered. Just be sure to bring a ship that can handle 32 SCU cargo containers. It also wouldn't hurt to bring a handheld tractor beam with you.
- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]
- [LOCATION 3]
Foxwell hasn’t been able to scout these locations, but if I were you, I’d expect to face some serious armed resistance. Best bring a bunch of gear and some friends.
Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
p13hxt.description_zh:
在旧的哈索尔采矿设施中发生了一些奇怪的事情。平台校准设施和轨道激光平台已经被废弃积灰了几十年，但不法分子开始将它们用作行动基地。

我们受雇于一个相关的客户，他最近被这样一个团伙抢走了大量重要货物。目前，他们的货物被藏在 [LOCATION1] 和 [LOCATION2]，但有人担心这个团伙可能很快就会转移货物。这就是为什么我们被雇佣同时袭击这两座哈索尔设施，从货运电梯取回货物，并将其送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯。

以下是每个位置需要取回的具体信息。无论你按什么顺序执行，只要确保所有货物都被收集并送达即可。记得确保你有一艘能处理 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 集装箱的飞船。

而且带上一个手持式牵引光束也没啥坏处。

[MULTITOSINGLETOKEN]

福克斯韦尔还未能侦察这些地点，如果我是你的话，我会预计到会遇到一些严重的武装抵抗。最好带上大量装备和一些朋友。

1uzkk7j.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
We’re having trouble completing a hauling mission and need a reliable contractor who has experience working in dangerous environments to complete the job. Just as a heads up, the cargo is in an abandoned ship surrounded by multiple, highly dangerous outlaws. We strongly advise you bring some backup with you and heavy-duty tractor beam to retrieve the client’s goods. Details follow:
RECOVERY LOCATION
· [LOCATION]
DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
Since this is a bit risky, we’re offering proportionate pay. I’ll leave it up to you to decide how to distribute it to your crew.
TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.
1uzkk7j.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

我们正在为一项货运任务发愁，急需一位有在危险环境作业经验的可靠承包商来完成这项工作。提前提醒你，货物位于一艘废弃飞船上，周围有多个极其危险的不法分子。我们强烈建议你带些帮手，并自带重型牵引光束来取回客户货物。详情如下：

找回地点
     · [LOCATION]

卸货地点
     · [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯

由于这项任务有一定风险，我们提供相应的报酬。至于具体如何分配给你的组员，由你自行决定。

以你的工作为荣 - 即使你是外包承包商，你也代表红风货运。切勿故意做出任何损害公司声誉的行为。

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Seems a pilot of ours ran into some trouble and left a client’s delivery unfulfilled. We suspect they may no longer be with us, but it’s important that we continue to offer outstanding levels of service and complete the job. If you accept, please head to [LOCATION] to pick up the packages. Be advised you may encounter some opportunistic outlaws near the derelict ship.
PACKAGES TO RECOVER
· 2x [ITEM1]
DROP OFF LOCATION
· Deliver to [DESTINATION]
TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

vz9idp.description_en:
Our crew at [LOCATION] needs help. Enemy ships are swarming the area and attacking anything and everything they can find. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site has some absolutely crucial gear and personnel that we can’t have destroyed or compromised.
Considering the size and scale of the attack, you’re gonna need a fully supplied ship and some reliable wingmen. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and I’ll send you specifics on where you’re needed most.
To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn a bonus 9 Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.
- Stow
vz9idp.description_zh:
我们在 [DEFENDLOCATIONWRAPPERLOCATION] 的船员需要支援。敌方飞船正在这片区域疯狂出没，见什么打什么。这已经够糟了，但这个地点还有一些极其关键的设备和人员，绝对不能被摧毁或者落入敌人手里。

考虑到这次袭击的规模，你得有一艘全副武装的飞船，再带上几个靠谱的僚机伙伴。召集你的队伍，飞到现场，我会告诉你最需要支援的具体位置。

为了表明我们对完成任务的重视程度，只要确保一切顺利，没有任何闪失，主承包人将会获得一笔额外奖金：[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

si16sc.description_en:
RSI are hosting a Discovery Month event and are contracting security services to provide some additional protection. There's gonna be a lot of high value items at each of these locations, so we need people doing regular patrols to make sure it goes off without a hitch.
Start by flying out to the patrol point on your HUD. Got a few places for you to scan before we can report back to the client that everything's safe.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
si16sc.description_zh:
RSI 正在举办探索月活动，雇了安保服务来提供额外防护。每个地点都会有一堆高价值物品，所以我们需要人手定期巡逻，确保一切顺利进行。

先飞到 HUD 上的 巡逻点。有几处地方要你去扫描，扫完我们才能回报客户说一切安全。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

LOCATION: [SYSTEM]

Complete this mission to get blueprints for Volt weapons. For this test, these blueprints have some slots that accepting different materials for varying stat adjustments.
[LOCATION] There have been reported kopion sightings within the area, so caution is advised.
For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

urdb1f.description_en:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around [LOCATION] that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering [TARGET] who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.
Word is that [TARGET] is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid.
You know, the usual.
Stows out.
urdb1f.description_zh:

据说 [TARGETNAME] 在一艘船上，但可能依靠基地的防御来保护自己，所以要小心。杀了他们，就能拿到报酬。

你知道的，老规矩。

Every day it seems like Citizens for Prosperity is out here trying to snatch up more people for their shitty little cause and make life more difficult for hardworkin' folks like ourselves.
I figure they could use a reminder about who really is in charge here. Head to [LOCATION] and really mess the place up.
Nothing like a bit of property damage to get a point across.
-Stows out

每天看起来繁荣公民都在这里试图拉拢更多人加入他们那可怜的事业，这让像我们这样辛勤工作的人生活得更艰难。

我想他们需要一个提醒，告诉他们谁才是真正的掌控者。去 [LOCATION] 那儿，好好把那个地方给搅个天翻地覆。

没有什么比一些财产损失更能传达这个信息了。

7la2ea.description_en:
Well done!
With the first part behind you, you should now have some basic familiarity with the movement controls, managing your hunger and thirst, and some of the core functionality of your mobiGlas – namely the Contract Manager and your Journal.
This next section will help you familiarize yourself with [LOCATION] and take you to visit [STORENAME], a weapons store here in [LOCATION].
You can shop there, and at other stores like it, using United Earth Credits (UEC). During the Alpha phase of Star Citizen’s development, we will be using a currency called aUEC (Alpha United Earth Credits). This is a temporary currency specifically designed for testing the in-game economy and balance.
7la2ea.description_zh:
干得漂亮！

在完成了教程的第一部分后，您现在应该对基础移动控制、自身饥渴状态管理、还有一些mobiGlas的核心功能——即合约管理和日志都有所了解了。

接下来的部分将会帮您熟悉一下 [LOCATION]，并带您去逛一下 [LOCATION] 的武器店 [STORENAME]。

您可以使用联合地球信劵（UEC）在这些商店中进行购物。在星际公民的阿尔法测试阶段，我们会使用名为aUEC（阿尔法联合地球信劵）的货币。这是一种专门用于测试游戏内经济和平衡系统的临时货币。

1trlpjs.description_en:
Hey again,
I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
1trlpjs.description_zh:
嘿你好，

所幸他们所在的区域安全一些，不太会有麻烦潜伏，但如今世事难料。还是尽快让他们恢复航行比较好。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部

1vis7p4.description_en:
This’ll be a fun one for you. We just got word that a transport ship has broken down at [LOCATION]. Only problem is, every skag and their mother seems to know about it. Place is crawling with all kinds of outlaws trying to get their hands on the cargo onboard. That’s where you come in.
If you can get your best pilots together and a heavy-duty tractor beam you can take out the competition and snag the cargo. It ain’t gonna be easy though. One of my scouts said the assholes guarding this ship have got some serious tech on them.
I’ve already got a buyer waiting, you just need to take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll send you the creds.
Stows out.
1vis7p4.description_zh:
这对你来说会是个有趣的任务。我们刚收到消息，有一艘运输船在 [LOCATION] 那儿抛锚了。问题在于，好像所有的不法分子都知道这件事。那儿到处都是想抢走船上货物的混蛋。这就是你需要发挥作用的地方。

如果你能召集你最厉害的飞行员，并且准备好重型牵引光束，那么你就能击败那些对手拿到货物。不过这不会容易的。我的一个侦察员说，守着那艘船的家伙们有一些很厉害的装备。

我已经找好了买家，你只需要把货物送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿，我就会把报酬给你。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

Plus, you don’t have to worry much about any distractions while you’re workin’ since you’ll be near one of our stations and we make sure folks behave themselves.
- Smokey

1mg4c60.description_en:
Not sure how the hell this happened, but my pilot’s gone and got themselves killed over at [LOCATION]. If you want to die on your own time, that’s your business, but they did it while carrying a stash for me. Now I gotta have someone go out there and finish their work.
Take the two packages to [DESTINATION] and I’ll have one of my crew collect it later. If you see those assholes who took out my pilot, give ‘em hell.
-Twitch
1mg4c60.description_zh:
不知道这鬼事情怎么发生的，我的飞行员居然在 [LOCATION] 那边挂了。你想死你自己去死呗，这不关我事，但他们死的时候还背着给我带的货。现在我只能找人去把他们的活儿给干完了。

你把那两个包裹送到 [DESTINATION]，我手下稍后会来取。要是碰上那些干掉我飞行员的王八蛋，替我好好教训他们。

-刺痛

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION]
Reminder, since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

6cz86e.description_en:
For any pilots in the area – a group of bandits is targeting one of our clients at [LOCATION], specifically their [OBJECTS] and the maintenance ships that manage them. From our intel, it's only a few outlaws trying to make some quick credits, but they're also the type to cause some real damage if you get in their way.
If you take care of them and relocate the client's ship and crew safely, we’re offering 2 MG Scrip to the main contractor.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
6cz86e.description_zh:
致区域内所有飞行员 - 一群匪徒正袭击位于 [LOCATION] 的我们的一位客户，目标直指其[OBJECTS]以及负责维护的飞船。据情报显示，对方仅由少数不法分子组成，企图快速捞一笔，但一旦有人挡路，他们也会造成严重破坏。

若你能击退他们，并安全转移客户的飞船与船员，我们将向主承包商支付 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为奖励。

祝好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

The folks at [LOCATION] have what I like to call a “pilot’s special” waiting to be distributed - a haul of quantum fuel, hydrogen fuel, and ship ammo. Load it up from a freight elevator and deliver it to the following spots in whatever order works best for you. Expect the containers to all be 16 SCU or smaller.
DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION1]
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
